description: This file implements a service layer for OpenAI's language models, providing context aggregation, class implementations for aggregators, and methods for handling function calls, image frames, and context creation specific to OpenAI's features within a larger AI application.

classes.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: A deprecated container class holding a pair of OpenAI-specific context aggregators for user and assistant messages, providing accessors for each.

classes.name: OpenAILLMService
classes.description: A service class extending BaseOpenAILLMService that provides OpenAI-specific context aggregators and initialization for model configurations.

classes.name: OpenAIUserContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific user context aggregator class inheriting from LLMUserContextAggregator, mainly for type distinction with potential deprecation handling.

classes.name: OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: An OpenAI-specific assistant context aggregator class inheriting from LLMAssistantContextAggregator, with methods to handle function call progress, results, cancellations, and image frame handling.

methods.name: "OpenAIUserContextAggregator" user(self)
methods.description: Returns the user context aggregator instance.

methods.name: "OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator" assistant(self)
methods.description: Returns the assistant context aggregator instance.

methods.name: OpenAIContextAggregatorPair create_context_aggregator( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
methods.description: Creates and returns a pair of OpenAI-specific context aggregators, deprecated in favor of a more general approach.

methods.name: handle_function_call_in_progress(self, frame: FunctionCallInProgressFrame)
methods.description: Handles an ongoing function call by adding a message to the context with IN_PROGRESS status.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result(self, frame: FunctionCallResultFrame)
methods.description: Processes the result of a function call, updating the context accordingly.

methods.name: handle_function_call_cancel(self, frame: FunctionCallCancelFrame)
methods.description: Marks a function call as canceled within the context.

methods.name: _update_function_call_result( self, function_name: str, tool_call_id: str, result: Any )
methods.description: Helper method to update the content of a message associated with a specific tool call ID.

methods.name: handle_user_image_frame(self, frame: UserImageRawFrame)
methods.description: Processes a user image frame to mark the related function call as completed and appends the image to the context.

ctags.name: _update_function_call_result
ctags.signature: ( self, function_name: str, tool_call_id: str, result: Any )

ctags.name: create_context_aggregator
ctags.signature: ( self, context: OpenAILLMContext, *, user_params: LLMUserAggregatorParams = LLMUserAggregatorParams(), assistant_params: LLMAssistantAggregatorParams = LLMAssistantAggregatorParams(), )
